how: Proposing the dart and supplying its working design instantiate starting, while joining is recorded separately as an answer.
The opening invitation asks members to represent the room on the canvas.
A renewed call asks contributors to restore and defend the dart.
Volunteering, accepting a call, and thanking a contributor occur in bare replies.
A defense call directly receives a bare acceptance and then thanks.
The invitation receives an affirmative script offer, followed by reported construction.
An opening invitation can perform starting and calling together, so a separate start before the first call need not be observable.
Members choose an identifiable dart, revise its text, and propose a second dart.
Contributors report blue filling and the dart approaching completion.
Design images and coordinates make the target available, with direct location answers when a link is difficult to use.
A helper is corrected to keep the second dart at the first dart's height and acknowledges the error.
A posted template coordinates provisional work without ending later design revisions.
A script is offered while an image is still needed, then shared with automatic placement instructions.
Construction can already be scripted before the recorded calls about takeover pressure.
The recorded introduction of scripting precedes takeover calls, leaving defensive strain unsupported as its initiating cause here.
Following a shared plan also requires adblock troubleshooting and direct coordinates.
The official and unofficial apps handle the coordinate link differently, prompting an explanation of which app opens the target.
Contributors propose taking turns around sleep and answer when current defenders will go to bed.
Voluntary offers, corrections, and a proposed sleep handoff cannot establish the absence of formal ordering throughout the incomplete record.
A Discord-hosted design and an ordinary Facebook planning group do not establish that canvas decisions moved into chat.
Tracing a lettering change does not establish concealed strategy or infiltration of a rival venue.
Members defend the dart against changes and recount repeatedly fixing the blackened tip.
The unfinished dart is already defended, making upkeep overlap construction.
The planned-change-erased-by-uninformed-keepers clause is untestable because acknowledged extension errors and lettering conversions do not establish keepers erasing an agreed revision.
Participants report attempted lettering changes and acknowledge one editor's mistaken conversion.
Members identify open space and an initial location for the dart before any recorded loss.
Different initial and later coordinates do not establish that erasure or loss caused relocation.
The shortage-to-relocation mechanism lacks an explicit shortage judgment and a loss-linked move.
A person apologises for converting the lettering, promises to undo it, and receives thanks.
Acknowledgment of a mistaken conversion supplies an apology route without requiring a recorded border agreement.
A neighboring participant praises the design and receives reciprocal thanks.
One contributor reports helping another flag and offers attention to the dart without claiming a bargain between rooms.
Reciprocal greetings alone do not establish a strain-driven request for outside help or delivered defense.
An apology and acknowledgment do not establish border negotiation or a treaty.
Defense reports do not establish subsequent border negotiation in the supplied concepts.
The apology is observed without an evidenced prior border agreement, leaving the agreement-based mechanism untested.
Neighbor greetings supply neither an evidenced border agreement nor a resulting exchange of help.
Divided individual assistance and neighbor greetings do not establish coalition formation.
Helping two works does not establish that defensive strain caused a coalition.
A second-dart proposal establishes no host's grant of governed space or protection.
A neighbor greeting and a person's apology do not establish representation as an envoy.
The apology and acknowledgment express neither disputed authority nor limits on committing a group.
Without an evidenced agreement or statement about representative authority, the bounded agreement-to-limit mechanism cannot be tested.
Helping two works establishes neither membership in both rooms nor conflict of allegiance.
Apologising for a mix-up does not establish a general argument over the fairness of covering others' art.
Existing hobby knowledge makes an air-release-hole joke intelligible without establishing that the joke predated the canvas.
The remaining black spot becomes a planned-air-hole joke that receives a reply celebrating participation in the silliness.
Participants receive a playful name arising from the dart defense.
The organizer reports fighting off swastikas while finishing the dart.
The attributed takeover and confessed mistake do not establish a quarrel inherited from before the canvas.
The concepts do not identify a pre-existing tie as the reason to attack a rival.
An effort's nickname does not establish a new canvas room, chat, or negotiating body.
Readers recognize April Fools blaster pranks and the fake defacement is revealed as tape and Photoshop.
A range-test title performs an isolated joking reversal with no coded reception.
Participant-created political humor receives praise, a subscriber claim, a revised prediction, and continuing objection without establishing official provenance.
A political-video objection and public-club wording rule do not establish containment of canvas posts.
Calls and acceptances do not establish a post flood followed by a boundary decision.
The political-video objection does not say the speaker attacked the room's mark because of canvas posts.
Completion declarations and personal credit mark the dart as a collective achievement.
Construction reports precede completion declarations, with the achievement remaining the participants' contested account.
A timelapse is used to recount the dart's persistence to the conclusion.
Participants recount repeated live repairs and a last attempted fix as placement ended.
The celebration thread becomes a setting for recording the dart's fate through a timelapse and repair accounts.
Retrospective live-repair stories and an explicit joke do not establish archival cleanup or correction of a disputed historical account.
Future ordinary club plans do not establish a decision to preserve the temporary canvas effort.
A timelapse account and ordinary club plans do not establish recording-led continuation of the canvas effort.
A contributor is taught the manual five-minute placement rule during the build.
After completion a question about the picture receives an explanation of the event and its rule.
A lapsed hobbyist and a club president explicitly attribute returning or joining to the canvas contribution.
Arrivals receive welcome, hobby updates, trading routes, event information, and practical club advice.
Reception articulates public-language rules while combining welcome with a blunt warning.
An introduction attributing entry to the canvas directly receives an offer of ordinary club-running help.
Plans for future participation establish intentions by different speakers, leaving implementation and lasting membership unresolved.
Identifying the Elite-dart design basis does not establish outreach to outside creators, companies, teams, or press.
Incoming conversion requires explicit actor attribution and cannot establish an outgoing attack by the receiving room.
A call to restore the room's own dart requires an explicitly outward target before it can explain attacking a rival.
The supported conversion-to-apology exchange concerns one confessing editor rather than an evidenced room-wide attack call and refusal.
The admitted conversion and thanks express no treaty or border proposal.
A complaint about one tip-blackening person does not identify a rival-room contest.
Retrospective individual blame does not identify the rival room required for the proposed attack-to-contest mechanism.
An extension correction followed by acknowledgment does not establish a personal quarrel or withdrawal under strain.
A takeover report and a help call do not explicitly establish a judgment that manpower or space was inadequate.
